content: LLM output cache in Postgres: Standard pattern is a table with (organization_id, cache_key, content, model_used, created_at, expires_at). Cache key = hash of org_id + prompt_version + date. TTL via expires_at checked at query time (WHERE expires_at > now()). Per-org isolation mandatory — never share across orgs. Per-day cache: cache_key = sha256(org_id || date). Eviction via pg_cron DELETE WHERE expires_at < now(). No pgvector needed for exact-match cache (only needed for semantic search). Version bump on prompt change invalidates stale cache without deletion.
